 One of Pearl Jam’s live bootleg CDs.  Recorded on March 3rd 2003 at Nippon Budokan, one of the 5 shows of Japan tour, and released on CD in 2003. This is the long-awaited re-issue, to celebrate Eddie Vedder’s first solo tour in Japan.

items.title_orig: Eddie Vedder Earthling Japan Tour Edition
items.article_text:
Produto: Eddie Vedder Earthling Japan Tour Edition
Vendor: Music
Formatos: Japan Tour Edition
Limited Edition

6 panel Digisleeve with Obi strip, Poster and Japanese leaflet inserted

 A limited Tour Edition of Eddie Vedder’s latest album “Earthling” (2022), to celebrate his first solo tour in Japan. This is a 2CD product, with DISC 2 which includes the 6 tracks on the digital EP “Matter Of Time” and the digital singles “Save It For Later” and “Room At The Top”, all 8 tracks are released on CD for the first time.

 Tracklisting:

Invincible
